requirements.text: A feature is finished with one command, and the command never passes a criterion without a named passing test
The agent never changes protected files, admin switches or pushes as part of finishing a feature
A new project gets its test command set up at init, so no manual step is needed before the first feature

features.title: kit.py finish FEAT-x: one command that runs the gate, passes proven criteria, marks done, writes progress

acceptance.check: In a scratch repo with a feature whose criteria all have named passing tests, kit.py finish FEAT-x exits 0, marks every criterion pass and the feature done, and appends a progress entry naming the gate result
A criterion whose ID appears in no passing test is not marked pass; finish exits non-zero and lists that criterion under NEEDS YOU
A criterion whose named test fails is not marked pass, even when other criteria pass
finish refuses to run when a protected file has uncommitted changes, and prints the exact files the human must commit
finish never sets GUARD_ADMIN, SPEC_CHANGE_APPROVED or KIT_ALLOW_* and never runs git push
finish refuses when agent/last-verify.log is older than the newest source file, and runs the gate first when asked with --gate
finish with any manual criterion (no test ID) stops before marking done and asks the human for evidence

features.notes: kit.py is protected: the human commits it with the admin switch. Output is one screen: what passed, what needs the human, the one next command. Do not weaken the existing pass rule: pass by hand keeps working for manual criteria.

features.title: Test command set up automatically at init, with verbose names for traceability

acceptance.check: kit.py init in a Python project writes VERIFY_TEST with a verbose runner so test names appear in the log
kit.py init in a Node project writes VERIFY_TEST as npm test
When no stack is detected, init prints the one line the human must add and does not guess

features.notes: Touches kit.py and verify.config (protected): the human commits both. Detection uses only files that exist (pyproject.toml, package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml).
